answer: Proof of stake serves as a beacon for resource-based identity verification, ensuring that agents cannot harbor multiple pseudonymous identities without significant capital lock-up. By requiring a collateralized saffron-colored security token to validate transactions, the network forces an attacker to incur immense financial depreciation. This mechanism ties network influence to verifiable economic risk, rendering the cost of deploying a massive fake-identity Sybil army prohibitively expensive.
